grammar.title: Learn Grammar
grammar.subtitle: Pick a topic — read a clear, friendly lesson, then check yourself with a quiz.

noKey.title: Lessons & most quizzes are completely free
noKey.body: Read every lesson and take the quizzes with NO key at all. You only need your own free Gemini key (aistudio.google.com/apikey) to ask questions or take a few extra quizzes — add it in Settings.

howTo.title: How it works
howTo.point1: A step-by-step lesson: roadmap, bullet points, formula boxes and wrong → right examples
howTo.point2: A quiz (up to 10 questions) to check what you learned
howTo.point3: Scores are saved to your Progress page

motivation.perfect: Outstanding! A perfect score — you've mastered this topic. Time to learn a new one! 🎉

motivation.ok: Good effort! Read the lesson once more with focus, then take the quiz again — you can do it. 📖
motivation.low: No worries — mistakes are where learning starts! Read the lesson first, then try again. 🌱

weak.doneNote: Keep quizzing these topics normally — this list updates itself as you improve.

noKey.title: Most lessons work offline — no key needed
noKey.body: Foundation (Beginner) and Advanced topics open instantly from our own lesson library, in your language. Intermediate lessons and extra fresh content use AI — add your free Gemini API key (aistudio.google.com/apikey) in Settings. Your key is encrypted and stays completely private.
